born.name: George Smalridge

born.name: Joseph Butler

born.name: Nicholas II of Russia
born.cause: quoting Jesus to Yakov Yurovsky upon being informed he and his family were to be put to death
born.last_words: You know not what you do.

born.name: Thomas Midgley Jr.
born.cause: The 55-year-old American chemical engineer, best known for inventing leaded gasoline and chlorofluorocarbon gas, contracted polio in 1941, which left him severely disabled, leading him to devise an elaborate system of ropes and pulleys to lift himself out of bed. In 1944, he became entangled in the device and died of strangulation.

born.name: Vincent Chin
born.cause: just after being beaten with a baseball bat by Chrysler plant supervisor Ronald Ebens. Chin died four days later at Henry Ford Hospital
